relevance_note: Narrative review of Blau syndrome that gives individual-level details for a few patients, e.g. 'a young girl with a novel G464W substitution, who presented with an atypical phenotype comprising mild oligoarthritis'.
method_note: Narrative review; no patient tables. Built by a short Python script from my own reading; every span checked verbatim by script. Labels for previously published patients use the reference number as printed. Spans for source_reference_in_review include the line break before the bracketed reference, as in the Markdown. Included: the child pictured in Figure 1 (unnamed person 1); ref [15] infant; ref [22] aortitis patient; the unpublished young man who died of pulmonary hypertension at 22 (unnamed person 2); ref [23] girl (two passages, treated as one person because both cite [23] and describe Takayasu-like arteritis); ref [24] seizure patient; ref [25] pneumonitis child; ref [26] leukocytoclastic vasculitis patient and ref [26] nephritis case (kept as two rows because the review does not say they are the same person; they may be); ref [28] hepatic granuloma child; the registry individual with a substitution at position 802 (unnamed person 3); the ref [17] individual with classical Blau and E600A. Not given rows (group or count level only): the two registry patients with severe systemic hypertension [17]; three additional prospective-study patients with interstitial lung disease; the three-generation family with isolated granulomatous uveitis carrying E600A (number of members not stated); the E383K family of ref [40] (2 affected, 4 asymptomatic carriers, no per-person details); the 4 families of ref [3] (R334Q/R334W/L469F given per family, not per person); interstitial nephritis described in [27]; facial palsy [2,21]. The 'typical triad phenotype' of unnamed person 2 was recorded as a feature but the three triad checklist items were left not reported (not stated individually). Reference [26]'s title names R334Q, but the review text does not tie R334Q to either ref [26] person, so no variant row was made; the ref [25] patient's NOD2 variant is not printed (variant row 'not reported'). Ref [15] infant: '1 week old at presentation' recorded as detail of the dermatitis, not as onset or last evaluation. Ref [26] patient 2 has no disease label stated for that person (context only). Protein descriptions such as G464W and E600A lack a 'p.' prefix, so protein_hgvs_as_stated is null; variant type not stated by authors. cohort_size_as_stated = 31 (prospective study baseline); the review also cites 82 registry patients with NOD2 mutations (Figure 6) and 22 uveitis patients (Figure 5); n_patients_reported left null because no single count of described patients is stated. No contradictions found.
